lines.t: When they ask me, what church do you belong to, I just smile and say
I belong to the Lord, Yahushua, Mashiach
The one you call Jesus, Christ
I walk in his love, I obey his voice
Together with those who do the same
That's the church where I dwell
No building, no title, no creed can contain
The spirit that moves in his holy name
I'm bound by his mercy, redeemed by his blood
United in faith and still with his love
Love, love, love, love, love, love, love, love
Not named a man, not made by hands
Only your spirit helps me stand
The church without walls
The church without walls
Together with those who are here
Together with those who are here
The church where I walk
I belong to the Lord
Forever to the Lord
